title: security: rbac-v2 KMS region pinning + audit hardening
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: Customers running Redwood Private and Dedicated asked for stricter guarantees around KMS key residency and more actionable audit logs tied to RBAC v2 role assignments. This PR implements region pinning constraints for KMS-backed keys, enhances audit logging for RBAC v2 policy evaluations, and hardens validation paths to prevent cross-region key usage in policy bindings. Motivation: Prevent inadvertent data residency violations and improve incident triage by surfacing policy decision details in audit trails. Summary of changes: - Enforce region pinning at policy evaluation time for KMS keys referenced by RBAC v2 resources. Requests referencing keys outside allowed regions are rejected with clear error codes. - Add structured audit entries for policy evaluation decisions: include policy id, decision reason, matched principals, resource context, and KMS key fingerprint. - Add migration to backfill existing RBAC v2 bindings with inferred region metadata where possible and a dry-run flag for admins. - Bump RBAC v2 schema to include optional kms_region field and validation hooks in the private installer. - Add feature flag security.kms_region_enforcement to allow staged rollouts (off by default, admin-only enable). Backwards compatibility: New schema field is optional; enforcement is gated behind the feature flag. Operators can run the dry-run migration to discover affected bindings before flipping enforcement on. Testing and validation: - Unit tests for policy evaluation and KMS residency checks. - Integration tests exercising private installer with KMS region constraints. - End-to-end test simulating a cross-region key usage and confirming audit log contents. - Manual verification with a staging Dedicated cluster and example KMS aliases. Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main with feature flag disabled. 2) Run dry-run migration on Dedicated customers that opt in. 3) Enable enforcement for pilot customers; monitor audit logs and support channels. 4) Gradual ramp to 100% after 2 weeks of no regressions. Related tasks: ENG-4523 implements operator tooling for the migration; SEC-108 addressed threat modelling for cross-region keys. Commits list and changed files are summarized below.
